purpose: Non-sensitive design judgment for the implementation prompt; not software verification
question: Which spatial revision best preserves a cozy pixel RPG neighborhood while making the accepted community concept less cramped?
state: The approved concept has six districts: central plaza, north shelter/clinic, east market, west park, four southern owner home plots, and a jeepney stop along the south road. Preserve 32px tile scale and current character/building proportions. Proposed revision: 80 by 56 logical tiles instead of roughly 64 by 48; four 14 by 14 private plots separated by five tiles; four-tile primary footpaths, three-tile secondary paths, clear entrances, restrained planting and open lawns. Existing Phaser housing editing, inventory authority and multiplayer persistence should be extended, not duplicated.

options.expand_world: Increase usable map area and district spacing while retaining sprite scale and all six districts
options.shrink_sprites: Fit the same composition by reducing sprite sizes and camera zoom
options.remove_districts: Remove existing districts and private yards to keep the original footprint

decision: Preserve sprite scale and accepted districts; expand usable world geometry, reduce decorative clutter and adapt the existing housing editor and authority. The model judgment does not validate the future implementation.
